goal: Protect peer transaction relay data against concurrency regressions and deadlocks
Eliminate fragile recursive locking by hiding relay internals behind clear boundaries
agreement: Strong support with earlier concurrency and encapsulation concerns resolved
Confirmed non-recursive locking and verified thread safety improvements (pablomartin4btc)
Support for encapsulating relay state instead of bare mutex swaps (sedited)
Objections to leaking mutexes and callbacks under lock were addressed (maflcko)
Concept approval without stated reasons (hebasto, theuni)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it is an internal concurrency cleanup in P2P transaction relay processing
Reduces deadlock risk and simplifies locking rules without user-visible changes
